feature_contract.identity: Launch identity is same-Session ActorId plus retained event generation plus caller occurrence. Duplicate occurrence returns its existing projectile id without creating another record. Binding lease renewal clears projectile state and launch keys.
feature_contract.owned_state: Only projectile position, normalized forward, source speed/timer, the prior-frame Box2D-unit XY velocity, source visual data, and pending contact identity are owned. Each non-paused frame first integrates the prior XY velocity at100 game units per Box2D unit, then records this frame's source speed command, then applies damping/timer; Z is unchanged. ActorState/HP/pose/target/FSM and source RNG remain with their Session/source owners.
feature_contract.contact_result: Actual contact is supplied as a typed same-Session ActorId event. Contact filters require source AI_IsEnemy provider where source requires it. `runtime_session_projectile_melee_hit_v1` reads the actual selected ProjectileTable row's field8 magic byte and the caller's current inventory mainhand ItemTable word37; it emits the recovered mask/category/element/direct-amount inputs. The runtime calls CombatSession::apply_source_result only on the following update, using that Session's shared RNG/result owner, and follows actual low outcome bits for continuation.
feature_contract.render: visuals() returns a value packet containing original model URI and current position/forward/yaw; it creates no renderer object. Expiry and character-impact packets retain distinct source FX/sound fields.
feature_contract.frame_adapter: runtime_session_projectile_frame_v1 performs current-binding sync, one update, post-update revalidation, impact/result consumption, current visual snapshot, pre-submit revalidation, and the renderer module's existing submit callback. It creates no contact and does not infer impact from launch, distance, or overlap. A render failure returns false with updated/consumed values retained in output, so callers handle them without replaying simulation.

validation.result: PASS same-Session Staff01 row20 state5 launch, retained occurrence, real NativeWorld unit/cadence comparison, paused/dt/timer, direct result/RNG parity, frame ordering, material/URI fail-closed, stale/destroyed Session guards
validation.fixture_notes: Strict C++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror private executable compiles the current CombatSession TU and links copied read-only archives under .local-inputs/runtime-session-projectile-v1/private-libs; assets are a private overlay. Actual Mage wand BDAE marker and current Staff01 ItemTable row are decoded. The16ms fixture steps a genuine NativeWorld body before runtime update, writes row20 velocity after that step, then compares next-frame runtime XY displacement with dh2_native_body_query using a pitched normalized forward vector; both use32*forward.xy game units and runtime Z remains unchanged. This verifies XY units and phase cadence, not a production fixed16ms cadence. The projectile hit provider uses actual ProjectileTable row20 field8 magic and current inventory mainhand Item word37. A direct `dh2_combat_melee` calculation from the same Session combat sheets, equipment facts, and pre-hit RNG matches all ten fields in the Session pending resolution, applied receipt amount/outcomes/mask, and post-hit shared RNG. Frame tests verify launch/no-contact creates no impact/result; paused dt preserves position and submits a retained draw frame; a typed contact result/impact is consumed once before the next render submit; material refusal is fail-closed with output retained; unknown URI cannot submit; stale/destroyed Session frames do not submit. Unknown URI is tested at renderer input because current Mage row20 is the only projectile row reachable through this live Staff01 caller. Session callback/lifecycle coverage remains bounded to the existing `apply_source_result` prefix.
